title: Shared console shell navigation
summary: Every authenticated console route shares one desktop navigation rail with expanded and compact presentations, while narrow screens use one right-edge drawer with the same destination identities.

includes: Shared console chrome for Overview, Apps, AgentOS and Wallet routes
Desktop rail expanded and compact presentations
Visible keyboard-operable collapse and expand control
Persisted collapse preference and adjacent body reflow
Circular icon-only compact destinations with accessible labels
Pinned controls with destination-group internal scrolling
Right-edge mobile navigation drawer with the complete destination set
excludes: Standalone routes for unavailable Servers, Domains or Support destinations
Backend API or data ownership changes

actors.label: Authenticated account owner
capabilities: Navigate every available console destination and choose a persistent compact or expanded desktop rail

flows.title: Navigate the shared console shell

steps.action: Read the expanded destination rail and activate the visible collapse control
steps.result: The same rail host becomes compact and the routed body reflows

steps.action: Traverse circular icon destinations or activate the expand control
steps.result: Navigation remains operable and the expanded rail is restored

steps.action: Open and close the right-edge drawer on a narrow viewport
steps.result: The complete destination set remains reachable without a bottom tab bar

outcomes: The account owner keeps one stable way to navigate across every console route and viewport

rules.statement: The destination collection preserves one selected key, keyboard traversal, focus-visible feedback and the same destination order on every console route.
The desktop rail has exactly two persisted presentations: expanded at 256px and collapsed at 64px, toggled by one visible keyboard-operable control while the adjacent body reflows.
Collapsed destinations keep stable circular glyphs, accessible labels and target size; visible copy may disappear but destination meaning may not.
Collapse control and Overview remain pinned while only long destination groups own internal scrolling.
Below the desktop breakpoint the standing rail and bottom tab bar are absent; one right-edge drawer exposes the complete destination set.

surfaces.title: Console navigation
surfaces.purpose: Keep navigation identity, state and interaction stable while routed console content changes.

regions.title: Desktop console rail
regions.summary: One stable rail toggles between expanded labels and compact circular glyphs.

regions.title: Mobile console drawer
regions.summary: A visible menu control opens the complete destination set from the right edge.

acceptance.statement: Every authenticated console route renders the same expanded or collapsed desktop rail state without remounting its host.
A visible keyboard-operable toggle changes the desktop rail between 256px and 64px, persists the choice and reflows the routed body.
Compact mode retains circular icon targets, accessible labels, selected state and destination order.
Only destination groups scroll; toggle and Overview remain pinned.
A narrow viewport exposes all destinations in a right-edge drawer and renders neither desktop rail nor bottom tab bar.

evidence.claim: The authenticated route-group layout mounts one shared mobile navigation owner, one desktop sidebar owner and one routed main body.
Console navigation owns the complete grouped destination set, selected route, desktop ListBox and mobile right-edge drawer composition.
The shared SelectionList delegates single-selection and keyboard mechanics to HeroUI ListBox.
The shared DrawerBranch owns right-edge placement, backdrop, focus, dismissal and the single drawer body.
Interaction tests prove seven desktop destinations, the complete mobile drawer set, disabled routes and locale-aware activation.

The owner explicitly requires the shared Nivo console shell to implement the full StarCi collapsible navigation grammar: a visible collapse control, persisted 256px-to-64px rail, compact circular icon destinations, pinned controls, internal group scrolling and the existing right-edge mobile drawer across Dashboard and AgentOS.
